original_question: Otu ugbo watermelon mịpụtara  nwa watermelon 120. Ashlyn gara n'ugbo ahụ mgbe ọnwa abụọ gachara wee chọpụta na 30% watermelon adịgo njikere maka owuweihe ubi, ya mere o welara ha ụlọ. Mgbe ọ lọghachitere azụ ka izu ụka abụọ gasịrị, 3/4 melon fọdụrụ adịgo njikere, ya mere ọ ghọrọ ha. Kedu melon ole na-adịghị njikere owuweihe ubi mgbe izu abụọ gasịrị?
question_template: Otu ugbo watermelon mịpụtara nwa watermelon {num_digit_1, 120}. {name_female, Ashlyn} gara n'ugbo ahụ mgbe ọnwa {num_text_1, abụọ} gachara wee chọpụta na {num_digit_2, 30}% watermelon adịgo njikere maka owuweihe ubi, ya mere o welara ha ụlọ. Mgbe ọ lọghachitere azụ ka izu ụka {num_text_2, abụọ} gasịrị, {num_frac_1, 3/4} melon fọdụrụ adịgo njikere, ya mere ọ ghọrọ ha. Kedu melon ole na-adịghị njikere owuweihe ubi mgbe izu {num_text_2, abụọ} gasịrị?
question_solution: answer = num_digit_1 * (1 - num_digit_2/100) * (1 - f1)   # f1 is the numeric value of num_frac_1
